It lists the 15 requirements tagged in [artifact:prj-5d67729821.interface-spec.a1]: TMR-PARAM, TMR-RESET, TMR-REG-RW, TMR-READ, TMR-START, TMR-COUNT, TMR-WRITE-WINS, TMR-STOP, TMR-LOAD-LATE, TMR-EXPIRE, TMR-PERIODIC, TMR-ONESHOT, TMR-W1C, TMR-SET-WINS and TMR-IRQ. Each is quoted from interface_spec.md, and every one is named by at least one planned test, assertion or coverage point. Assertions cover the cycle-exact priority rules: write-wins, set-wins, the irq equation, and combinational rdata. Coverage points cover the mode, IE and corner crosses. A reviewer should read each item's proves list against the requirement text, because the check compares IDs only."}

=== FILE: verification_plan.json ===
{
  "format": "nirmaan.vplan",
  "version": 1,
  "requirements": [
    {"id": "TMR-PARAM", "section": "1. Parameters", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "The block works for every `W` from 4 to 32, and bits `W` and up of the `LOAD` and `COUNT` registers read as zero; a write to `LOAD` ignores them."},
    {"id": "TMR-RESET", "section": "4.1 Reset and registers", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "While `rst_n` is low at a rising edge of `clk`, `CTRL`, `LOAD`, `COUNT` and `STATUS` clear to zero."},
    {"id": "TMR-REG-RW", "section": "4.1 Reset and registers", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "A write to `CTRL` stores `wdata` bits 2 to 0 in it, and a write to `LOAD` stores `wdata` bits `W-1` to 0 in it."},
    {"id": "TMR-READ", "section": "4.1 Reset and registers", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "A read never changes any register; `rdata` follows `addr` with no clock edge."},
    {"id": "TMR-START", "section": "4.2 Counting", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "At a rising edge where a write to `CTRL` sets `EN` and `EN` was 0, the count loads the `LOAD` value."},
    {"id": "TMR-COUNT", "section": "4.2 Counting", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "At a rising edge where `EN` is 1 and the count is not zero, and no write to `CTRL` takes place, the count falls by one."},
    {"id": "TMR-WRITE-WINS", "section": "4.2 Counting", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "A write to `CTRL` takes the place of that edge's count step: at that edge the count does not fall and the timer does not expire, whatever the count was."},
    {"id": "TMR-STOP", "section": "4.2 Counting", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "A write to `CTRL` that clears `EN` stops the timer and the count keeps its value."},
    {"id": "TMR-LOAD-LATE", "section": "4.2 Counting", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "A write to `LOAD` does not change the count: the new value is used at the next start or periodic reload."},
    {"id": "TMR-EXPIRE", "section": "4.3 Expiry", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "At a rising edge where `EN` is 1 and the count is zero, and no write to `CTRL` takes place, the timer expires: `EXPIRED` is set."},
    {"id": "TMR-PERIODIC", "section": "4.3 Expiry", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "In periodic mode an expiry also loads the count with the `LOAD` value, and `EN` stays 1."},
    {"id": "TMR-ONESHOT", "section": "4.3 Expiry", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "In one-shot mode an expiry also clears `EN`, and the count stays zero until the next start."},
    {"id": "TMR-W1C", "section": "4.4 The flag and the interrupt", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "A write to `STATUS` with bit 0 set clears `EXPIRED`, and with bit 0 clear changes nothing; it never sets the flag."},
    {"id": "TMR-SET-WINS", "section": "4.4 The flag and the interrupt", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "A timer that expires at the same rising edge as a write that clears `EXPIRED` keeps `EXPIRED` set."},
    {"id": "TMR-IRQ", "section": "4.4 The flag and the interrupt", "source": "interface_spec.md", "text": "`irq` is high exactly when `EXPIRED` and `IE` are both 1, in one-shot and periodic mode alike; it follows the registers with no clock edge."}
  ],
  "items": [
    {"id": "T-SMOKE", "kind": "test", "file": "tick_timer_tb.sv", "name": "tick_timer_smoke", "proves": ["TMR-START", "TMR-COUNT", "TMR-EXPIRE", "TMR-ONESHOT", "TMR-IRQ"], "rationale": "Stimulus: after reset, write LOAD=5 and then CTRL=EN|IE in one-shot mode. Check: COUNT steps 5..0, EXPIRED sets on the edge after COUNT reaches 0, EN clears, COUNT stays 0, and irq goes high."},
    {"id": "T-PARAM-WIDTH", "kind": "test", "file": "tick_timer_tb.sv", "name": "tick_timer_param_width", "proves": ["TMR-PARAM", "TMR-REG-RW"], "rationale": "Run the register and counting tests with W=4, W=16 and W=32. Stimulus: write all-ones to LOAD. Check: LOAD and COUNT read back with bits W and up as zero, and a count from the maximum W-bit value expires correctly."},
    {"id": "T-RESET", "kind": "test", "file": "tick_timer_tb.sv", "name": "tick_timer_reset", "proves": ["TMR-RESET"], "rationale": "Stimulus: put nonzero values in CTRL, LOAD, COUNT (running) and STATUS (expired), then hold rst_n low for one or more edges, including mid-count. Check: all four registers read zero and irq is low."},
    {"id": "A-RESET", "kind": "assertion", "file": "tick_timer_sva.sv", "name": "a_reset_clears_all", "proves": ["TMR-RESET"], "rationale": "Property: if rst_n is low at a clk edge, then on the next cycle CTRL, LOAD, COUNT and STATUS are all zero."},
    {"id": "T-REG-RW", "kind": "test", "file": "tick_timer_tb.sv", "name": "tick_timer_reg_access", "proves": ["TMR-REG-RW", "TMR-READ"], "rationale": "Stimulus: random writes to CTRL and LOAD. Check: CTRL reads back wdata[2:0] with other bits zero, LOAD reads back wdata[W-1:0], and STATUS bits above 0 read zero."},
    {"id": "T-ILLEGAL-WRITE", "kind": "test", "file": "tick_timer_tb.sv", "name": "tick_timer_illegal_write", "proves": ["TMR-READ", "TMR-REG-RW"], "rationale": "Illegal-stimulus focus area. Stimulus: write to COUNT, which is read-only, and write ones to unused CTRL and STATUS bits. Check: no register changes beyond what the spec defines."},
    {"id": "A-READ-COMB", "kind": "assertion", "file": "tick_timer_sva.sv", "name": "a_rdata_follows_addr", "proves": ["TMR-READ"], "rationale": "Property: in every cycle, rdata equals the register that addr selects, as a combinational check with no edge delay. Registers do not change on cycles where we is low, except through counting, expiry or reset."},
    {"id": "T-START", "kind": "test", "file": "tick_timer_tb.sv", "name": "tick_timer_start_loads", "proves": ["TMR-START"], "rationale": "Stimulus: start from EN=0 with several LOAD values, including 0 and the maximum. Also write CTRL with EN=1 while EN is already 1. Check: COUNT takes the LOAD value only on a 0-to-1 transition of EN."},
    {"id": "A-START", "kind": "assertion", "file": "tick_timer_sva.sv", "name": "a_start_loads_count", "proves": ["TMR-START"], "rationale": "Property: if we is high, addr is CTRL, wdata[0] is 1 and EN is 0, then on the next cycle COUNT equals LOAD."},
    {"id": "A-COUNT", "kind": "assertion", "file": "tick_timer_sva.sv", "name": "a_count_decrements", "proves": ["TMR-COUNT"], "rationale": "Property: if EN is 1, COUNT is not 0, and there is no write to CTRL (a LOAD or STATUS write is allowed), then on the next cycle COUNT equals the old COUNT minus 1."},
    {"id": "T-WRITE-WINS", "kind": "test", "file": "tick_timer_tb.sv", "name": "tick_timer_ctrl_write_wins", "proves": ["TMR-WRITE-WINS"], "rationale": "Stimulus: write CTRL (keeping EN=1, changing MODE or IE) at an edge where COUNT is nonzero, and again at an edge where COUNT is 0. Check: COUNT does not fall and EXPIRED does not set at that edge."},
    {"id": "A-WRITE-WINS", "kind": "assertion", "file": "tick_timer_sva.sv", "name": "a_ctrl_write_blocks_step", "proves": ["TMR-WRITE-WINS"], "rationale": "Property: on a CTRL write with EN already 1 and EN kept at 1, COUNT keeps its value and EXPIRED does not rise at that edge."},
    {"id": "T-STOP", "kind": "test", "file": "tick_timer_tb.sv", "name": "tick_timer_stop_holds", "proves": ["TMR-STOP"], "rationale": "Stimulus: clear EN partway through a count and wait many cycles. Check: COUNT holds its value and no expiry occurs."},
    {"id": "T-LOAD-LATE", "kind": "test", "file": "tick_timer_tb.sv", "name": "tick_timer_load_late", "proves": ["TMR-LOAD-LATE", "TMR-PERIODIC"], "rationale": "Stimulus: write a new LOAD while the timer is running, in both one-shot and periodic mode. Check: COUNT is unaffected at the write, the next periodic reload uses the new value, and the next start uses the new value."},
    {"id": "A-LOAD-LATE", "kind": "assertion", "file": "tick_timer_sva.sv", "name": "a_load_write_no_count_change", "proves": ["TMR-LOAD-LATE"], "rationale": "Property: a write to LOAD with no CTRL write changes COUNT only through the normal count step or expiry rule at that edge."},
    {"id": "A-EXPIRE", "kind": "assertion", "file": "tick_timer_sva.sv", "name": "a_expire_sets_flag", "proves": ["TMR-EXPIRE"], "rationale": "Property: if EN is 1, COUNT is 0 and there is no CTRL write, then on the next cycle EXPIRED is 1."},
    {"id": "T-PERIODIC", "kind": "test", "file": "tick_timer_tb.sv", "name": "tick_timer_periodic", "proves": ["TMR-PERIODIC", "TMR-EXPIRE"], "rationale": "Stimulus: run periodic mode over several periods, including LOAD=0. Check: each expiry reloads COUNT from LOAD, EN stays 1, and the period is LOAD+1 cycles."},
    {"id": "A-PERIODIC", "kind": "assertion", "file": "tick_timer_sva.sv", "name": "a_periodic_reload", "proves": ["TMR-PERIODIC"], "rationale": "Property: at an expiry edge in periodic mode, on the next cycle COUNT equals LOAD and EN is 1."},
    {"id": "A-ONESHOT", "kind": "assertion", "file": "tick_timer_sva.sv", "name": "a_oneshot_stops", "proves": ["TMR-ONESHOT"], "rationale": "Property: at an expiry edge in one-shot mode, on the next cycle EN is 0, and COUNT stays 0 until the next start."},
    {"id": "T-W1C", "kind": "test", "file": "tick_timer_tb.sv", "name": "tick_timer_status_w1c", "proves": ["TMR-W1C"], "rationale": "Stimulus: write STATUS with bit 0 = 1 when EXPIRED is set, write it with bit 0 = 0, and write it with bit 0 = 1 when EXPIRED is clear. Check: only the first write clears the flag, and no write sets it."},
    {"id": "A-W1C", "kind": "assertion", "file": "tick_timer_sva.sv", "name": "a_status_never_set_by_write", "proves": ["TMR-W1C"], "rationale": "Property: EXPIRED rises only at an expiry edge, never because of a STATUS write."},
    {"id": "T-SET-WINS", "kind": "test", "file": "tick_timer_tb.sv", "name": "tick_timer_set_wins", "proves": ["TMR-SET-WINS"], "rationale": "Stimulus: with EXPIRED already set, write STATUS=1 at exactly the edge where the timer expires again, in periodic mode and in one-shot mode. Check: EXPIRED is still set."},
    {"id": "A-SET-WINS", "kind": "assertion", "file": "tick_timer_sva.sv", "name": "a_expire_beats_clear", "proves": ["TMR-SET-WINS"], "rationale": "Property: if an expiry and a STATUS bit-0 write happen at the same edge, then on the next cycle EXPIRED is 1."},
    {"id": "A-IRQ", "kind": "assertion", "file": "tick_timer_sva.sv", "name": "a_irq_equation", "proves": ["TMR-IRQ"], "rationale": "Property: in every cycle, irq equals EXPIRED AND IE, as a combinational check with no edge delay, in both modes."},
    {"id": "T-STRESS", "kind": "test", "file": "tick_timer_tb.sv", "name": "tick_timer_random_stress", "proves": ["TMR-COUNT", "TMR-WRITE-WINS", "TMR-STOP", "TMR-LOAD-LATE", "TMR-EXPIRE", "TMR-PERIODIC", "TMR-ONESHOT", "TMR-W1C", "TMR-SET-WINS", "TMR-IRQ"], "rationale": "Stress focus area. Stimulus: long constrained-random sequences of register writes and reads, with occasional resets. Check: a cycle-accurate reference model compares every register and irq on every cycle."},
    {"id": "C-MODES", "kind": "coverage_point", "file": "tick_timer_cov.sv", "name": "cg_expiry_mode_ie", "proves": ["TMR-PERIODIC", "TMR-ONESHOT", "TMR-IRQ"], "rationale": "Cross of expiry events with MODE (one-shot or periodic) and with IE (0 or 1)."},
    {"id": "C-CORNERS", "kind": "coverage_point", "file": "tick_timer_cov.sv", "name": "cg_priority_corners", "proves": ["TMR-WRITE-WINS", "TMR-SET-WINS", "TMR-START", "TMR-PARAM"], "rationale": "Bins for the corner cases: a CTRL write at COUNT=0 with EN=1, a CTRL write at nonzero COUNT, expiry at the same edge as a STATUS clear, LOAD=0, and LOAD equal to the maximum W-bit value."}
  ]
}
=== END FILE ===

result.detail: Plan shape follows the knowledge document verification/verification_planning. Item kinds are used as follows. Tests carry the directed and random stimulus, and each test is planned together with its scoreboard or reference-model check. Assertions cover the cycle-exact priority rules: write-wins, set-wins, the irq equation, and combinational rdata. Coverage points cover the mode, IE and corner crosses. The focus areas from the knowledge document are included: smoke, register access, illegal writes (writes to the read-only COUNT and to unused CTRL/STATUS bits) and stress. A reviewer should read each item's proves list against the requirement text, because the check compares IDs only.
